description_en: Uploads a file from a public URL to local or cloud storage. This is an asynchronous operation. You can call the ListFiles operation to monitor the upload progress
description_zh:
上传一个文件。基于外链URL（公网可下载文件）实现文件上传到本地/云存储。
属于异步操作，可通过ListFiles接口查询上传进度
kebab_example: aliyun vs upload-file --file-name mytest --origin-url https://xxx.xxx.xxx.tar --md5 150b6083f50dd08159d45a0d5e4b56f9 --target-path /data/tmp/test/xxx.tar --region cn-hangzhou
name: UploadFile

parameters.help_en:
A custom file name. The name must be unique and serves as a unique identifier for the file. The name must meet the following requirements:

It must be 8 to 255 characters in length.

It can contain lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.).

The first and last characters must be a letter or a digit
parameters.help_zh:
自定义文件名，不可重复，将作为文件的唯一标记之一。
默认取值规范：
长度8-255
小写字母、数字、下划线'_'、中划线'-'、点分段'.'
首、尾字符必须为字母或数字
parameters.name: file_name

parameters.help_en: The download URL of the file
parameters.name: origin_url

parameters.help_en: The MD5 hash of the file. This is used to verify the integrity of the file
parameters.help_zh: 文件md5，用于检查文件完整性
parameters.name: md5

parameters.help_en:
The destination path on the service instance. This must be an absolute path to a file. You cannot specify only a folder. The parent folder of the destination path is restricted to the following locations:

/data/local

/data/user

/data/data

/data/cache

/data/tmp

/data/storage

/data/media/0
parameters.help_zh:
向云应用服务实例推送的目标路径，必须是绝对路径，不支持输入目录。目标路径所在上级目录有范围限制，取值范围：
/data/local
/data/user
/data/data
/data/cache
/data/tmp
/data/storage
/data/media/0
parameters.name: target_path

FileId.description_en: The ID of the file. This ID is unique for each file
FileId.title_en: 文件ID，对应唯一的文件，如f-xxx
FileId.title_zh: 文件ID，对应唯一的文件，如f-xxx
